lines.arrive: A sunny afternoon. The sun is warm on your face, and everything feels real.
lines.solid: The grass, the trees, the warmth. All of it feels solid.
lines.edge: The world ends here. Just past the edge, it flickers.
lines.ask: If none of this were real, how would you ever know?
lines.fall: You step off the edge. In the real version, there would be no edge to find.
lines.lab_1: A brain, in a jar of fluid. Wires. A humming machine. And above it, the world you just left.
lines.lab_2: So this is what's real. Isn't it?
lines.layer_2: Another brain. Another machine. Another world above it.
lines.sit: You sit down. The sun is warm.
lines.stay_end: Real or not, it's the only sun you have.
lines.end: However far you step out, you're still looking through the same eyes.
lines.tree: A perfect tree. Every leaf exactly where you'd expect it.
lines.window: Nobody home. Come to think of it, you've never seen anyone go in.
lines.machine: Reels turning, lights blinking. Somewhere in here is that tree.
lines.machine_2: Up there, you called it a tree. Did you mean a real tree, or this machine's picture of one? The picture is all you've ever touched.
lines.sit_rest: You sit. The sun is warm, the grass smells of summer. You could sit here all afternoon, just feeling it.
lines.machine_3: Another machine. It's labelled in words you know. Your words.
lines.stool_end: You sit down by the machine. You've decided this one is real.
